# routeros_ip_packing (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `aggregated_size` (Number) Size of the aggregated packet that packing will try to achieve before sending.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `packing` (String) How the outgoing packets of this interface are processed.
  * none - no processing.
  * simple - aggregate several small packets into one large packet.
  * compress-headers - aggregate and compress the IP headers.
  * compress-all - aggregate and compress both headers and payload.
- `unpacking` (String) How the incoming packets of this interface are processed.
  * none - no processing.
  * simple - unpack aggregated packets.
  * compress-headers - unpack and decompress the IP headers.
  * compress-all - unpack and decompress both headers and payload.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
